description: Read-only inventory of a Bubble® app before moving its data to Cloudflare D1 and R2: data types, fields, relations, option sets, record counts, types the Data API does not expose, and a risk list with the estimated workload the export would use. Nothing is written to the app. Pass app_spec (app-spec.json from the nocode-migration-audit plugin) for privacy rules and workflow counts, or editor_catalog (the Bubble MCP list_types output) when you have no app_spec. Better: call nc_connect first, have the owner enter the Data API token and upload the catalog on its page, then pass job_id here with no token or catalog. Returns a job_id for nc_plan.

app_base_url.description: The app's address, for example https://yourapp.bubbleapps.io or its custom domain.

app_spec.description: app-spec.json from the nocode-migration-audit plugin (spec version 0.1).

data_api_token.description: A Data API token from the app's Settings > API. Needed for record counts. Never stored after the audit. Prefer nc_connect with job_id: the owner types tokens on a secure page. Only pass it here if nc_connect is not available.

detail.description: Apps with more than 30 types get a summary of the biggest types by default. full returns everything.

editor_catalog.description: The output of the Bubble MCP list_types tool, used for the schema when there is no app_spec.

job_id.description: A job from nc_connect: its sealed Data API token and uploaded catalog are used.

job_secret.description: The job_secret returned when this job was made (or the job's signed editor link). Required with job_id when no API key is sent: the job_id alone does not open a job.

source.description: The source platform. Bubble apps only in v1.

version.description: Which database to count. Default live.

name: nc_audit
title: Audit a no-code app (free)
